items.title: U.S. CFTC chief puts staff on notice to create crypto regulations if Clarity Act fails
items.summary: Commodity Futures Trading Commission Chairman Mike Selig told the inaugural gathering of the Innovation Advisory Committee that his agency won't sit idle.

items.title: CFTC Chair Readies Crypto Rules If Congress Fails to Pass Clarity Act
items.summary: The CFTC chair said staff is already exploring a crypto market structure framework and could move quickly to propose rules if Congress fails to act.

items.title: Alibaba's Revenue Jumps 9% as AI Cloud Growth Hits 45%—But a Profit Plunge Sends Shares Lower
items.summary: Cloud and AI product revenue accelerated in the June quarter, but a 75% drop in net income extended Alibaba's run of profit misses to a fifth straight quarter.

items.title: Ondo executive says tokenization is following the same path as early ETFs
items.summary: The firm hopes that passage of the Clarity Act will help open the door for it to offer tokenized products in the U.S.
